description: Append-only observation of a society-level STOCK (an accumulation, never an individual) at a point in valid-time, estimated from a pre-published public archive. The datom model: this record is one immutable fact [stockId, level, validTime] with the substrate supplying tx-time history. G6 STRUCTURAL: aggregate-only — no per-person entity, no PII (individualModeled const false). G9 STRUCTURAL: immutable — once written it is never retracted or overwritten (mutable const false). G3 STRUCTURAL: sourceCid MUST resolve to an e7m-dataset-managed public archive (passiveOnlyAttested const true). On kotoba-kqe this maps to :junkan.stock/* datoms (ADR-2605262130).

createdAt.description: tx-time (substrate assigns the canonical T; this mirrors it)

stockId.description: Stable identity of the society-level stock, e.g. routable-address-inequality / open-data-availability / regional-connectivity

level.description: Estimated stock level at validTime (integer in the units given by `unit`; scale chosen so fractional precision is unnecessary, e.g. basis points / per-100k)

validTime.description: When the world was observed (distinct from tx-time)

sourceCid.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: IPFS CID of the pre-published public archive this estimate derives from

estimationMethod.description: How the level was estimated from the source (e.g. aggregate-count / gini / shannon-entropy)

individualModeled.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: const false — society-level only, never an individual

mutable.description: G9 STRUCTURAL: const false — append-only datom; never retracted/overwritten

passiveOnlyAttested.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: const true — PASSIVE-ONLY per ADR-2605262400
